# Prelude first study

[The inert first packet](first.json.gz) retains 69 records: nineteen complete
projects, their predictions, twenty-four actual CLI observations, the explicit
Bell artifact and the original observer. It is an informed requirements study
at `6eb45164`; merged `d74d60ce` has the same source tree. It is not a blind
usability benchmark or an implementation result.

Explicit Bell checking, execution and IR emission succeed. The two identity
shadows and explicit Basis identity execute to zero. Existing collision,
wrong-category, missing-static-argument and explicit false-pure cases reject.
Desired implicit names, the opt-out header, reexports and qualified calls fail
at their original name/parser boundaries. The prelude false-pure example fails
early on missing `init0`; its explicit-import control reaches the actual effect
error. The private qualified example fails in parsing, not visibility checking.

The monitored source/binary coordinates remain unchanged across the first
observations. Those coordinates are not an atomic filesystem trace or a
source/binary attestation. Positive controls use at most two qubits. Numerical
distributions, native acceptance and general source preservation remain distinct.

The bounded passive reader pins 215,917 expanded bytes and never runs saved
sources, commands, the observer or the artifact. Subsequent implementation and
validation must retain these original bytes and record repairs separately.
